name: Firewall
description: iptables/ipset allowlist firewall with domain-based rules and DNS capture for domain discovery

install_extension.description: Install the Firewall Monitor VS Code extension (allowlist view, session-domain revoke, runtime allow-event toasts). The .vsix is bundled in the feature image and copied at build time; failure is non-fatal.

enabled.description: Enforce the allowlist firewall. Set false to allow all outbound traffic while still running the DNS capture daemon, so every requested domain is still logged (list-attempts.sh / firewall-dns.log) — useful for auditing what a container talks to before locking it down.
